title: Greek Lemon Potatoes
description: Oven-roasted potatoes braised in lemon, garlic, and oregano until crispy outside, creamy inside
ingredients: 2 lb russet or Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Arrange 2 lb potato wedges in a single layer in a large baking dish.
Whisk together 1/3 cup olive oil, 1 cup stock, the juice of 2 lemons, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 1/2 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Pour over the potatoes and toss to coat.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes so the potatoes soften and absorb the liquid.
Remove foil, flip the potatoes, and continue baking for 30 minutes until the liquid mostly evaporates and the tops turn golden and crisp.
Let rest 5 minutes, then spoon any remaining pan sauce over the top before serving.
notes: If the potatoes still look wet after the uncovered bake, broil for 3-5 minutes to crisp them up. These pair perfectly with the tzatziki you're already making.
